annotations.title: Score a page for AI citation

description: Score one web page for how likely an AI engine is to quote it: whether it answers the question directly, how its headings read, whether it carries structured data and sources, and how much of its prose reads as machine-written. Returns a score out of 50, the band it falls in against a measured sample of B2B pages, and the findings to fix. Use it on a page about to be published or one that is not getting cited. Takes a full page URL.

url.description: A full page URL, like https://acme.com/services/managed-it.
